text.content:
June 2070: one phone call, one supercarrier, and a Free City.

When: June 2070
Where: Night City and Coronado Bay
Who was involved: Councilman Lucius Rhyne, Arasaka, the NUSA
What it changed: Night City became an international Free City; Arasaka came back; Hansen stayed

Councilman Lucius Rhyne made a call to Tokyo. The next morning an Arasaka supercarrier sailed into Coronado Bay and the NUSA stopped. The Arvin Accord followed: Night City became an international Free City, part of no nation, and the NUSA withdrew. Rhyne was confirmed Mayor by acclamation the week after.

The Price

  • Arasaka got the Watson waterfront and the old NorCal base as extraterritorial land, the last lot on the Corporate Plaza ring, and a non-voting chair at every Council session, filled by Michiko Arasaka as Accord Liaison.
  • Everyone registered as a resident on the day became a Free City citizen. NUSA citizens now need a visa to enter.
  • Colonel Hansen ignored his withdrawal order and kept a slice of Pacifica: the Occupied Zone.

Accord Day in June now means free drinks paid by the Mayor's office and fireworks over the carrier. Who gave Rhyne the number to call is the city's favorite question.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.16; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05
